features.title: Agents act in your DSH window
features.summary: client_tools_list shows the open DSH browser windows and the client tools other plugins declare in them; client_tool_call runs one (open Settings at a section, open a tab), or a chain of up to 20 with steps in one round trip stopping at the first failure, in the window showing the Agent's thread or the one it names, and returns the results. A PTC-mode (Code Mode) agent calls both from a run_code program. The window shows one notice per call for the changes it made.
reach: fill textbox "Message or run a task*" "[[call client_tool_call {\"tool\":\"settings_open\",\"input\":{\"section\":\"General\"}}]]"

configuration.constraints: Boolean; off refuses every client_tool_call with a message naming this setting.
Boolean; a notice names each page-changing action an Agent ran. Read-only tools never notify.

failureModes: No DSH window is open: the call is refused with the step to open one.
The named window closed or never answers: window-closed at once on leave, timeout after timeoutMs otherwise.
No window offers the tool: the refusal lists the tools the window does offer.
Invalid input: the window replies with the schema validation error and runs nothing.
Switched off in Settings: every call is refused with the setting to turn on.
A chain stops at the first failing step: the Agent is told which step failed, why, and what already ran in the window; the later steps do not run.

onboarding.firstAction: Ask an agent to open Settings at the Plugin Market for you.
onboarding.doneWhen: Settings opens at Plugin Market in your window and a notice names the agent's action.

features.title: Window presence
features.summary: Each DSH browser window (one id per tab, kept across a reload) announces its focus, the thread it shows and its client tools, re-announces after a Host restart and every 30 s, and leaves when the page closes; the Host forgets a silent window after 90 s.
failureModes: A window that closes without pagehide stays listed until the 90 s TTL drops it.

verification.reason: Presence has no screen of its own; the agent-opens-settings journey lists this window through client_tools_list, which only works once the window announced itself.
